reviewer: Claude（Claude Code 会话）：faster-whisper small.en 与 medium.en 两档逐词转写交叉核对，并对照本地抽帧；未人工听音

foreground_english.zh: 那段时间我过得很艰难。

foreground_english.en: You know, I pushed at the beginning.
I thought that I just need to stay very strong, tough, and just keep practicing.
foreground_english.zh: 以为只要够坚强，坚持训练就行。

foreground_english.en: Yeah, but then I just couldn't get out of bed anymore.
foreground_english.zh: 可后来，我连床都起不来了。

foreground_english.en: I was just like lifeless, to be honest.
foreground_english.zh: 说实话，我整个人没有一点生气。

foreground_english.en: And yeah, I knew that I need to take a break because otherwise I'm just not able to
foreground_english.zh: 我知道必须停下来，不然的话，
我觉得我都没法好好生活。

foreground_english.en: Yeah, I needed to take a break.
And I honestly didn't know if I'm gonna come back or not, to be like honest with you.
foreground_english.zh: 说实话，我不知道还会不会回来。

foreground_english.en: Yeah, but after like months I decided to come back.
foreground_english.zh: 但几个月后，我决定回来。

foreground_english.en: I needed to kind of figure a few things in my head, I would say.
foreground_english.zh: 我得先把脑子里的一些事想清楚。

foreground_english.en: Yeah, and I came back. I'm happy that I did.
foreground_english.zh: 我回来了，我很庆幸自己回来了。

review_note: 法网官方频道 2026 法网八强后的赛后发布会（1ihxUf32bQk）：记者问停赛那段日子。两档逐词一致（medium 333.56–391.38；small 328.90–391.30），YouTube 自动字幕同。段首 333.2 在上一句 before the break I would say（333.02）之后，段尾 391.6 在下一个提问（395.22）之前。
